run_flair_ner_predict: run the Flair NER model to predict named entities in a list of sentences
create_flair_ner_model: create a Flair NER model instance using SequenceTagger for named entity recognition
get_ner_model: get a Flair NER model instance by calling the get_model factory function
review_ner_model_base_class: review the NER_model base class and its predict method signature for entity extraction
test_flair_predict_entities: test the Flair predict method to extract entities with sentence index and character positions
